title: Discovery status clobbered by a second server-side apply of the same tick

required_properties: A discovery tick records every status signal it learned in exactly one server-side apply of status.discovery, so no field or condition written earlier in the same tick is reverted

lastSuccessfulScanTime, lastDiscoveredCount and the Discovered condition (status, reason, message, lastTransitionTime) from a successful scan persist after the tick that also reports DiscoveryTruncated
The single apply still declares the complete status.discovery.conditions list this manager owns, so no condition the same manager owns is released and deleted
All discovery status writes stay under the single backup-discovery field manager and remain forced
The staleness gate selects the Discovered or DiscoveryFailed condition with the latest lastTransitionTime rather than the first stored match, so a schedule that has ever failed recovers its cadence
A healthy schedule creates a discover Job only when the selected signal is older than the stale threshold, and a fresh tick re-declares the current signal without moving its lastTransitionTime
The merge that folds a tick's updates into the listed status is a pure function with an injected now, covered by unit tests that would fail if a second apply or a stale base were used

Documentation and e2e state the real discovery cadence (T*(floor(S/T)+2) where T is the scan interval and S is the stale threshold, assuming the Job completes by the next tick) rather than max(scan_interval, stale_threshold), and no longer caveat the pruned-N-dangling message as transient
The bounded-deletion grace bounds the deletion hold against a stuck pre-deletion discover Job; the invariant test asserts it outlives BACKUP_JOB_TTL_SECONDS
Tests prove behaviour rather than restating the builder: an assertion that .force is true on locally built params is not accepted as coverage of the force
forbidden_changes: Narrow the applied condition set of the single discovery apply so a condition the same manager owns is released and deleted
Introduce a second field manager for status.discovery or split the tick across two applies
Change the DiscoveryFailed polarity or populate lastError (tracked in #1087)
Rename or otherwise change the namespaceUid wire field or move the tenants/ keyspace segment (tracked in #1084)
Assert in documentation or tests that a scan runs exactly every stale_threshold when the real period is T*(floor(S/T)+2)
Hand-edit charts/kaniop/crds/crds.yaml or files under examples/
Add a client-level test that only restates the PatchParams builder (for example asserting .force == true on params built in the same expression)
Delete or weaken the pruned-N-dangling suffix or the dangling-prune behaviour from #1083 to avoid the clobber

Change DEFAULT_SCAN_INTERVAL or BACKUP_DISCOVERY_STALE_SECS defaults merely to make the cadence match the docs or hide the bug; an explicitly authorized default change is permitted but this task does not require one (the fix and the cadence formula must hold with whatever stale threshold the repository carries)
